summary: Master stakeholder engagement and influence for project managers with practical tools, templates, and project-ready communication strategies. Enrol today.
lede: Stakeholder engagement training helps project managers and delivery teams identify whose decisions affect outcomes and plan purposeful involvement. Participants learn to map stakeholder influence and priority, tailor communications and escalation briefs, and address resistance or conflict while tracking engagement and reporting progress.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for people who work in project environments and need to influence decisions, manage resistance, and keep delivery aligned with stakeholder expectations.
prerequisites: You should have basic experience working on projects, contributing to meetings, or reviewing project reports. A laptop is recommended for workshop exercises using Excel, PowerPoint, or equivalent digital collaboration tools.
